next.reason: §2023:14.9.1.4 GR11 keeps the 8-digit unsigned hhmmsscc layout on a 24-hour basis with zero for unavailable fractions. Seconds run '00 through 59 when a LEAP-SECOND directive with the OFF phrase is in effect', and 'If the LEAP-SECOND directive is not specified, a LEAP-SECOND directive with the OFF phrase is implied' (§2023:7.3.17.4 GR1), under which 'a value greater than 59 shall not be reported in the seconds position' (§2023:7.3.17.4 GR3). A 1985 program has no directive, so its TIME range stays 00000000-23595999; the implementor-defined nn exists only under >>LEAP-SECOND ON, which no 1985 program contains. The adjudicate and recheck CHANGED answers missed the OFF default.
